towns.name: Greenspire
towns.summary: Greenspire (42.9N 66.9W, east coast of Marae Lassel) is one of the three human 'spire towns' settled after Candeth Martine opened the way to Marae Lassel in 12 PY, built around the remnant of a great Empyrean lighthouse; Viamontian forces took it in Thistledown 16 PY and it remains under New Viamont's control. Its signature is the 78 m stone tower on a z 28 knoll (helical rampway, shops of Brother Samir, Greygor Stillwise and Misha in its floating annexes) with three floating Advocate spires joined to it by bridges at z 60-114, each with a purple energy funnel (ritual tendril emitter + ethereal glow) underneath; the Life Stone and an Exploration Marker stand outdoors on the summit at z 99. Below, by the beach, two Sho-style bamboo halls, five blue-flame torches, a glowing obelisk with emitters and the Town Network portal; a gold-roofed lighthouse turret (26 m) stands on the road to the north-west; sea on the east and south (34 % water in the 3x3), the Unstable Portal at the tower's foot and the Destroyed Portal to Yaraq (crystal cluster, purple lights) on the south-west shore.

shots.standingOrder: Skim straight west 2.5 m above the sea toward the beach and the tower; hold the height over the water and stop 17 m short of the bamboo hall.
shots.notes: ESTABLISHING + WATER (drone.terrain-skim). Starts over deep water 200 m east of the beach and skims west at 2.5 m along y 34808 to the beach below the Town Network portal: the bay glitters below, the bamboo halls with their blue-flame torches and the swirling portal grow ahead, and the 78 m Empyrean tower with its three floating Advocate spires rises out of the top of the frame (tiltDeg +12 keeps the spires in view until the last 3 s). Sea terrain types 18/20 under the camera for 92 % of the move; the only thing close is a shallow-water plant clump.
